userStories.title: As an Account Management Specialist, I want to view premises and assigned services in the modern platform so that I can manage account infrastructure without the legacy system
As an Account Management Specialist, I want to review equipment and network information so that I can support account management activities from one platform
As an Internal User, I want to view bundles and service-order inventory in the unified platform so that I can complete account-related work with consistent data
As a Service Agent, I want to ask Mimir questions about customer and account data so that I can serve customers faster through natural language interaction
As a Service Agent, I want Mimir to summarize notes and trouble tickets so that I can understand account history more quickly
As an Internal User, I want Mimir to generate charts and insights from business data so that I can interpret operational information more efficiently
As a System Administrator, I want users to authenticate through WorkOS SSO so that only authorized personnel can access protected CM, AM, and Mimir functions
As a Compliance Administrator, I want user activity and data changes audited so that customer, account, and AI-assisted actions remain traceable
As a Release Manager, I want automated CI/CD pipelines with controlled promotion gates so that the platform can be continuously delivered with lower production risk
As a Service Agent, I want to use Mimir conversational assistance during customer servicing so that I can resolve questions faster
As a Compliance Officer, I want auditable history for customer, account, interaction, and AI-assisted activities so that the platform supports retention and compliance review
As a Release Manager, I want controlled promotion and rollback support across environments so that production deployments can be managed with lower service disruption risk
As a Service Agent, I want to search and open a unified customer workspace so that I can manage the complete customer lifecycle from one screen
As a Service Agent, I want to view customer addresses, notes, and alerts together so that I can handle interactions with full context
As an Internal User, I want to navigate between customer and account views without leaving the web platform so that I can complete related work efficiently
As a Customer Service Manager, I want modern web navigation across customer servicing capabilities so that teams can work more efficiently than in the legacy desktop software
As an Internal User, I want unified visibility into customer and infrastructure-related account data so that I can resolve service inquiries from one platform
